title: Scheduler agent: four behaviours contradict the design document and the user guide
description:
Found by the review of agent_scheduler against indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md and indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md. For each item decide whether the code or the documents are corrected, and keep both documents consistent with the result.

1. A missing IDLE hook task is skipped silently. SCHEDULER.md (Hooks) says a hook that names no task is reported by a message and skipped, and the guide (Messages) says the 'names no task' message exists also for the other hooks. process_idle() in indigo_agent_scheduler.c reports it for the startup, shutdown, night start, night end and resume hooks, but for the idle hook it only tests hook_slot() >= 0 and sends nothing.

2. SEQUENCE_NAME is recorded but never used. SCHEDULER.md says naming the sequence after the task lets the scheduler recognise its sequence in SEQUENCE_NAME, and the dependency table lists it as observed. observe_property() stores observed->sequence_name and nothing reads it; a run is identified only by the token and the Busy/finish event counters. Either use it or remove the field and the claim.

3. The message for a skipped saved task does not name the task. SCHEDULER.md (Persistence, Loading) promises a message naming the task. add_task() sends 'A saved task was skipped: <parser error>', and parser errors carry a line number, not the task name.

4. The full label text is not sent with list updates. SCHEDULER.md (Labels and list properties) says the full text, such as a long failure reason, is sent as the message of the update. AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASK_STATE, AGENT_SCHEDULER_PLAN and AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY are always defined and updated with a NULL message.

The lost failure reason of a sequence that ends Alert is already ticket 776f039c and is not part of this ticket. A behaviour fix needs a DRIVER_VERSION increment and test coverage in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c.
